title: 线性代数：三维方程组的行图像与列图像
titleEn: Linear Algebra: Row Picture vs. Column Picture for 3×3 Systems

sections.heading: 行图像（Row Picture）：三个平面相交于一点
sections.headingEn: The Row Picture: Three Planes Meeting at a Point

items.text: 在 3×3 问题中，每一行（每个方程）在三维空间中代表一个平面（plane），z 可以是任意值
items.textEn: In a 3×3 problem, each row (each equation) gives a plane in three dimensions; z can be anything

items.text: 两个方程（两个平面）相交于一条直线（line）——即两个平面相交的那条线
items.textEn: Two equations (two planes) meet in a line — the line where the two planes intersect

items.text: 第三个方程是第三个平面，三个平面相交于一个点（point），这个点就是方程组的解
items.textEn: The third equation is a third plane; the three planes meet in one point, which is the solution

items.text: 三个平面因为互不平行（not parallel）、不是特殊情形，所以确实交于唯一一点
items.textEn: Because the three planes are not parallel and not special, they do meet in exactly one point — the solution

items.text: 老师强调：行图像在二维时很容易看（两条直线相交），但三维中三个平面相交就不那么直观了
items.textEn: The row picture was a cinch for two lines meeting, but three planes meeting in 3D is not so clear

items.text: 在四维（four dimensions）中行图像更加难以可视化
items.textEn: In four dimensions, the row picture becomes even less clear

items.text: 行图像的核心结论：行图像由三个平面组成，若一切正常，三平面交于一点，即为解
items.textEn: Key takeaway of the row picture: it consists of three planes; if everything works right, they meet in one point — the solution

sections.heading: 列图像（Column Picture）：三个三维向量的线性组合
sections.headingEn: The Column Picture: Linear Combination of Three 3D Vectors

items.text: 老师明确表示他更偏好列图像（column picture）
items.textEn: The lecturer states he prefers the column picture

items.text: 列图像形式：x 乘以第一列 (2, -1, 0)，y 乘以第二列 (-1, 2, -3)，z 乘以第三列 (0, -1, 4)
items.textEn: Column picture form: x times the first column (2, -1, 0), y times the second column (-1, 2, -3), z times the third column (0, -1, 4)

items.text: 等式右边（right-hand side）为 b = (0, -1, 4)，即要组合的列恰好等于右端项
items.textEn: The right-hand side is b = (0, -1, 4); the columns must be combined to produce it

items.text: 等式左边是一个线性组合（linear combination），由三个三维向量（three dimensional vectors）组合而成
items.textEn: The left-hand side is a linear combination of three vectors, each being a three-dimensional vector

items.text: 核心问题：找到三个向量的什么组合（combination）能够产生右端向量 b
items.textEn: Core question: what combination of the three vectors produces the right-hand side vector b

items.text: 画图描述：第一列画为 (2, -1)，第二列 (-1, 2, -3) 画在某处，第三列 (0, -1, 4) 的第一个分量为 0、第二个为 -1
items.textEn: Drawing description: first column drawn as (2, -1); second column (-1, 2, -3) somewhere; third column (0, -1, 4) with first component 0 and second component -1

sections.heading: 本例的解：b 恰好等于第三列
sections.headingEn: The Solution: b Happens to Equal the Third Column

items.text: 老师特意（specially chosen by the lecturer）构造了这个问题：右端向量 b 恰好就是第三个列向量
items.textEn: The problem was specially chosen by the lecturer: the right-hand side b is actually one of the columns

items.text: 因此解为：x = 0, y = 0, z = 1 —— 只需要第三个向量，前两个取零
items.textEn: Therefore the solution is x = 0, y = 0, z = 1 — take one of column three and none of the others

items.text: 组合 (0, 0, 1) 正好就是之前三个平面相交的那个点（之前从行图像看不出）
items.textEn: The combination (0, 0, 1) is exactly the point where the three planes met, which couldn't be seen from the row picture

items.text: 本例中第三列与 b 完全相同（column three is the same as b），所以答案一眼可见
items.textEn: In this particular problem, column three is the same as b, so the answer is immediately visible

sections.heading: 预告：消元法与大图景
sections.headingEn: Preview: Elimination and the Big Picture

items.text: 老师强调：并非总能从列图像直接看出解，需要系统化的方法
items.textEn: The lecturer notes that the answer won't always be visible from the column picture either

items.text: 下一讲（next lecture）主题是消元法（elimination）——求解方程组的系统化方法
items.textEn: The next lecture is about elimination — the systematic way to solve the equations

items.text: 所有软件（every bit of software），包括大规模生产级软件，都用消元法来解方程
items.textEn: Every bit of software, including large-scale production software, solves equations by elimination

items.text: 消元法将在所有情形下求出 x, y, z（in all cases）
items.textEn: Elimination will find x, y, z in all cases

items.text: 老师引入『大图景』（big picture）：保持左边的矩阵不变，只改变右端项（right-hand side）
items.textEn: The 'big picture' idea: keep the same matrix on the left but change the right-hand side

items.text: 老师将右端项换成另一个同样相当特殊（pretty special）的向量，继续讨论
items.textEn: The lecturer changes the right-hand side to something that is also pretty special and continues the discussion
